entries.1e8df3ce7e00ecda: Its customers are manufacturers engaged in R&D and design and development, and requests for engineers come mainly from automotive-related manufacturers and semiconductor manufacturing equipment makers. Its largest customer is Honda Motor Co., Ltd.
entries.2367cfbe9125531d: It provides an engineer dispatch business, dispatching design engineers in the software, electrical and electronic, and mechanical fields to client companies, and a contracting and commissioned business, receiving design and development work from client companies.
entries.24ab990848881003: A technical field responsible for designing the circuit boards that form the core of devices and equipment, and for reliability evaluation.
entries.2cfa9e7764ee9905: The company states that since its founding in 1962 it has specialized in dispatching design engineers, and that as a pioneer in the industry it has built trust and a track record. Its foundation is a system in which Learning Centers, which centrally manage training for new-graduate engineers, are located in Suita, Osaka Prefecture, and Kohoku-ku, Yokohama, and engineers are developed and deployed through a cycle of recruitment, training, sales and support. Another feature is that it handles both dispatch contracts and contracting agreements, and can propose engineer selection, team dispatch, or organization into contracting and commissioned work according to client needs.
entries.3336e6d88f436eb5: This business undertakes design and development work commissioned by client companies, with the Group bearing full responsibility for work instructions, labor management of design engineers and so on, and delivers the finished work products. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥1,615 million.
entries.3e2ec2c828272b6e: Other businesses conducted by the Group in addition to the engineer dispatch business and the contracting and commissioned work business.
entries.43475a1bbe171bb1: Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥12,046 million. By business type, the engineer dispatch business accounted for ¥10,377 million, the contracting and commissioned business for ¥1,615 million, and other businesses for ¥53 million.

entries.5cd7aa283a32a6f2: The fiscal year ended January 2026 was the first year of preparing consolidated financial statements. Revenue reached ¥12,046 million, as the number of engineers and high utilization rates continued to rise, new-graduate engineers who joined in 2025 were deployed ahead of schedule, and strategic deployment into growth and high-value-added fields raised engineer unit rates. By business type, the engineer dispatch business was the core at ¥10,377 million, while the contracting and commissioned business was ¥1,615 million, partly reflecting projects shifting from dispatch to contracting and commissioned work.
entries.5f3bfb3c8b9916fc: This business dispatches design engineers employed by the company to the design and development departments of client companies. It operates from offices in Utsunomiya, Yokohama, Hamamatsu, Nagoya and Osaka, and provides specialized skills in software, electrical and electronics, and mechanical engineering. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥10,377 million.

entries.bbfd0c3088848aa3: The company’s customers are mainly automotive-related manufacturers and semiconductor manufacturing equipment makers that continue to invest in R&D and design and development, and requests for engineers from both fields remained strong in the fiscal year ended January 2026. Among major customers, Honda Motor Co., Ltd. is the largest, and Honda R&D Co., Ltd., which handles its research and development, is also among the major customers. Amid a continuing shortage of engineers, the company is positioned to advance the recruitment and development of engineers and their deployment into growth and high-value-added fields.

entries.ddff8e67b5608bb0: The company has set “building a foundation for sustainable and next-generation growth” as the basic policy of its medium-term management plan “Make Value for 2025 to 2029,” and its basic measures are expanding the weighting of personnel in high-end areas centered on carbon-neutral response, shifting strategically toward contracting and commissioned work, utilizing diverse talent, and evolving into a comprehensive technology services company through M&A and alliances.
